title: How Marketplace Orders Promise Delivery Dates and Close
content:
**Rule.** The promised delivery date of a Marketplace Orders order is the order date plus the option's maximum handling business days plus its maximum transit business days, counted on the option's business-day calendar. A delivered scan on or before the promised delivery date sets the delivery promise flag to met; a later scan sets it to missed. A carrier exception moves a shipped order to undeliverable with the carrier's exception reason. An order closes only when the later of the return window end and the Northloop Guarantee claim window end has passed and the order has no return without a settled refund and no claim without a final decision; an undeliverable order closes once it has been refunded or replaced in full.

## Order states touched by this rule

| From | To | When |
|---|---|---|
| shipped | delivered | the carrier posts a delivered scan; the delivery promise flag is set to met or missed |
| shipped | undeliverable | the carrier reports an exception (lost, destroyed, refused, returned to sender) |
| delivered | closed | the later of the two window ends has passed, no return awaits a settled refund and no claim awaits a final decision |
| undeliverable | closed | the order has been refunded or replaced in full |

## Worked example (hypothetical inputs)

A hypothetical order is placed on a Monday, in a week and the following week with no US federal holiday, on an option with 2 handling and 5 transit business days. Seven business days are counted on the Monday-to-Friday calendar from the order date: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday. The promised delivery date is the Wednesday of the following week.

- Delivered scan on that Wednesday: on the promised date, so the promise is met.
- Delivered scan on the Thursday after it: later than the promised date, so the promise is missed.

## Closing, by question

- **Does a delivered order close when its return window ends?** Only if the Northloop Guarantee claim window has also ended, because the later of the two ends governs, and only if no return is waiting for a settled refund and no claim is waiting for a final decision.
- **When does an undeliverable order close?** Once it has been refunded or replaced in full.
